2607.11412.title: Uncertainty Quantification for EO Regression Tasks: Building Height, Tree Canopy Height and Above-ground Biomass Estimation
2607.11412.paper_summary: Earth Observation regression tasks such as building height, canopy height, and above-ground biomass estimation underpin critical applications in urban planning, forest monitoring, and climate policy, where both accuracy and reliability are critical. Yet most deep learning models yield only deterministic predictions, providing no indication of per-pixel reliability. These regression tasks are inherently challenging due to heterogeneous land surfaces, skewed target distributions, sensor noise, and signal saturation at high target values, making uncertainty (UC) estimation essential for reliable inference. We address this gap by modeling aleatoric uncertainty using year-long Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 MSI time series, proposing two complementary approaches: (i) Gaussian UC, which jointly predicts mean and standard deviation under a Gaussian assumption, and (ii) Quantile UC, which estimates the 10th, 50th, and 90th quantiles to capture asymmetric and heteroscedastic error distributions. Both models are evaluated on three representative EO regression tasks at 10 m spatial resolution. Results show that both approaches match or surpass deterministic benchmarks and existing global products, while delivering well-calibrated, interpretable, and operationally useful confidence estimates. Notably, both models outperform the current 10 m state-of-the-art uncertainty-aware model for canopy height estimation. Our implementation will be available at: https://github.com/RituYadav92/EO-Regression-Uncertainty-Estimation
2607.11412.paper_summary_zh: 地球觀測回歸任務，如建築物高度、樹冠高度和地上生物量估算，支撐著城市規劃、森林監測和氣候政策等關鍵應用，其中準確性和可靠性至關重要。 然而，大多數深度學習模型僅產生確定性預測，未提供每個像素可靠性的指示。 由於土地表面的異質性、目標分佈的偏斜、傳感器噪聲以及在高目標值下的信號飽和，這些回歸任務本質上具有挑戰性，使得不確定性（UC）估算對於可靠推斷至關重要。 我們通過使用長達一年的Sentinel-1 SAR和Sentinel-2 MSI時間序列來建模隨機不確定性，以填補這一空白，提出了兩種互補的方法：（i）高斯UC，該方法在高斯假設下共同預測均值和標準差，以及（ii）分位數UC，該方法估算第10、第50和第90百分位數，以捕捉不對稱和異方差的誤差分佈。 這兩個模型在10米空間分辨率的三個代表性EO回歸任務上進行評估。 結果顯示，這兩種方法的表現與確定性基準和現有全球產品相匹配或超過，同時提供良好校準、可解釋且在操作上有用的置信估計。 值得注意的是，這兩個模型在樹冠高度估算方面的表現超過了目前10米最先進的不確定性感知模型。 我們的實現將在以下網址提供：https://github.com/RituYadav92/EO-Regression-Uncertainty-Estimation
